build_grpcio_package: build the grpcio Python package by running python setup.py with environment flags like GRPC_PYTHON_BUILD_WITH_CYTHON
check_linker_need_libatomic: test if the system linker requires libatomic by compiling a small C++ atomic snippet and checking the return code
cython_extensions_and_necessity: configure and return Cython extension modules for the grpc._cython.cygrpc module along with whether Cython is needed
review_setup_py_config: review the setup.py build configuration including platform-specific compiler flags, include directories, and extension libraries
summarize_grpcio_setup: summarize the grpcio setuptools setup including package metadata, dependencies, custom commands, and Cython extension configuration
